item.title: Judge blocks California’s ban on federal agents wearing masks but requires badges be clearly seen

item.description: Behavioral finance can play a role in anyone's decisions. Chasing trends like a crypto win or viral TikTok stock tip is something to be wary of.

item.description: As the search for Nancy Guthrie, the mother of "Today" show host Savannah Guthrie, enters its second week, a former Arizona law enforcement official shared his insights on the investigation into her disappearance.

item.title: FBI says it’s unaware of Savannah Guthrie talking with her mom’s suspected kidnappers
item.description: The FBI said Monday it is unaware of any continued communication between Savannah Guthrie’s family and suspected kidnappers more than a week after the “Today” show host’s mom went missing.

item.title: Bodycam footage shows what led up to Phoenix police officer shooting, killing the wrong man
item.description: The Phoenix Police Department released bodycam footage that shows the moments leading up to one of its officers shooting and killing the wrong man last month.

item.description: An immigration court blocked the deportation of a Turkish Tufts University graduate student who was detained by immigration officials near her Massachusetts home, her attorneys said in court documents filed Monday. item.title: Man charged with felony murder in connection with fatal Phoenix police shooting
item.description: The man who was the subject of a shooting call last month where a Phoenix police officer fatally shot the wrong man was charged with felony murder Monday.
